This is direct evidence that the program was translated into concrete priorities, timelines, and budget architecture.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Com 88 programas, PPA retoma participação social...","publisher":"Ministry of Planning and Budget","date":"August 30, 2023; updated December 19, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/planejamento/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2023/agosto/o-plano-plurianual-2024-2027-foi-entregue-hoje-ao-congresso-nacional-em-cerimonia-no-palacio-do-planalto","summary":"The government says the PPA restored social participation, set six priorities, and turned public priorities into an official four-year plan with a R$13.3 trillion forecast. This is concrete evidence of planning and budget translation.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Novo PAC Seleções invests R$23 billion in health, education, sport and culture","publisher":"Ministry of Culture","date":"March 7, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/cultura/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/novo-pac-selecoes-investe-r-23-bilhoes-em-saude-educacao-esporte-e-cultura/","summary":"Lula announced a specific spending package with 6,778 works and equipment, explicit sectoral allocations, and a focus on low-coverage municipalities. This is strong evidence of program-to-budget translation.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Decreto 12.066 regulates the PPA 2024-2027","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic / Planalto","date":"June 18, 2024","url":"https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12066.htm","summary":"Lula’s government created formal governance and management procedures for the PPA, including monitoring, evaluation, review, and alignment with annual budgets. This is concrete institutionalization, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"PPA open-data release","publisher":"Ministry of Planning and Budget","date":"April 5, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/planejamento/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/abril/mpo-pubica-os-atributos-legais-e-infralegais-do-plano-plurianual-2024-2027-em-formato-dados-abertos","summary":"The government published the PPA’s managerial attributes, priorities, and cross-cutting agendas in open data, including institutional and normative measures. This supports the claim that priorities were specified in operational form.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"SNAVE school-violence system","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic / Planalto","date":"April 24, 2024","url":"https://www.presidencia.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2024/decreto/d12006.htm","summary":"Lula created a standing national system to monitor and combat school violence, with prevention and response functions. This is a clear institutional and enforcement mechanism, not a one-off speech.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Bolsa Família decree","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic / Planalto","date":"June 17, 2024","url":"https://www.presidencia.gov.br/Ccivil_03/_Ato2023-2026/2024/Decreto/D12064.htm","summary":"The decree formalized health and education conditionalities, interministerial monitoring, and rules for sanctions/non-sanctions. This is concrete institutional design and a named response mechanism.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Yanomami anti-garimpo operations","publisher":"Ministry of Indigenous Peoples","date":"July 16, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/07/governo-federal-completa-mil-operacoes-realizadas-na-terra-indigena-yanomami-no-periodo-de-cinco-meses","summary":"The government reported 1,000 operations in five months, coordinated through the Casa de Governo, against illegal mining in Yanomami territory. This shows enforcement capacity being operationalized.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Spending freeze / fiscal constraint","publisher":"Ministry of Planning and Budget","date":"March 29, 2024","url":"https://www.gov.br/planejamento/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2024/marco/bloqueio-poupa-educacao-saude-e-ministerios-das-mulheres-igualdade-racial-e-direitos-humanos/","summary":"The government had to impose a R$2.9 billion freeze under the fiscal rule. Positive for execution, but it also shows the program had to be adjusted under market pressure.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Creative accounting criticism","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"September 18, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/analysisbrazils-tinkering-to-meet-fiscal-target-threatens-to-dent-credibility-3620814","summary":"Reuters reported increasingly creative accounting around spending and revenue to meet targets. This is the sharpest counterevidence that the formal policy architecture was not always cleanly executed.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Petrobras dividend interference","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"March 18, 2024","url":"https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/18/ministerio-publico-do-tcu-pede-investigacao-de-possivel-interferencia-do-governo-na-petrobras.htm","summary":"The TCU prosecutor sought an investigation into possible government interference in Petrobras’ dividend decision. This is evidence that Lula’s program could slide into discretionary steering of a strategic firm.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Central bank pressure","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"July 1, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/07/01/lula-critica-bc-autonomo-e-diz-que-autoridade-monetaria-nao-atende-populacao.htm","summary":"Lula publicly pressured the central bank and rejected the market’s framing of monetary policy. This weakens the “technocratic, evidence-based” reading of how he executed his economic program.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Indicted minister not removed immediately","publisher":"Reuters via UOL","date":"June 12, 2024; June 13, 2024","url":"https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/06/12/ministro-das-comunicacoes-e-indiciado-pela-pf-por-corrupcao-em-investigacao-sobre-desvio-na-codevasf-dizem-fontes.htm","summary":"Lula’s communications minister was indicted in a public-works corruption probe and Lula did not immediately remove him. This is the clearest patronage/capture caveat against clean implementation.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9","7B.10"]},{"title":"Budget pressure on social spending","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 5, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/forex-news/brazil-looks-at-curbing-health-education-spending-in-fiscal-package-sources-say-3703870","summary":"Reuters reported fiscal tightening could curb health and education outlays. This shows Lula’s priorities were not fully insulated from macro constraints.","question_ids":["8B.2"]}]}
